issues.label: Data Ownership Dispute
issues.summary: Farm data collected by precision equipment flowing to manufacturer cloud platforms without farmer control over access or monetization

circuits.detail: Data analytics platforms retaining farm-level data with unclear ownership and third-party sharing terms
GPS guidance and yield data locked in proprietary formats preventing farmer portability
Variable rate prescriptions requiring data submission to generate, creating vendor dependency
Drone imagery processed through cloud services with ambiguous data retention policies

issues.label: Connectivity Gap
issues.summary: Inadequate rural broadband and cellular coverage preventing real-time data transfer critical to precision agriculture systems

circuits.detail: RTK correction signals unavailable in areas lacking cellular infrastructure for NTRIP delivery
GPS guidance correction accuracy degraded from sub-inch to foot-level without real-time base station link
Cloud-based analytics inaccessible during field operations when connectivity is needed most
Yield monitor data stored locally and lost when equipment changes hands between seasons

issues.label: System Integration Failure
issues.summary: Incompatible data formats and communication protocols between equipment brands preventing unified precision management

circuits.detail: Variable rate controllers from different manufacturers unable to read common prescription formats
GPS guidance systems using proprietary coordinate reference creating field boundary misalignment
Yield data from different combine brands not mergeable into single field performance layer
Analytics platforms unable to ingest multi-source data without manual format conversion

issues.label: ROI Uncertainty
issues.summary: Precision agriculture technology adoption costs exceeding demonstrable yield or input savings on many field types

circuits.detail: Data analytics unable to isolate precision technology contribution from weather and management noise
Variable rate application producing inconsistent results on fields with limited spatial variability
Soil sensor data quality insufficient to generate reliable management zone boundaries
Autosteer investment payback period exceeding equipment trade cycle on small operations

issues.label: Cybersecurity Risk
issues.summary: Connected farm equipment and cloud platforms vulnerable to ransomware and data breach disrupting operations

circuits.detail: GPS guidance and autosteer systems vulnerable to spoofing attacks redirecting field operations
Cloud analytics platforms collecting sensitive yield and financial data without adequate encryption
Tractor telematics accessible remotely with potential for unauthorized equipment control
Drone flight control systems using unencrypted communication channels vulnerable to interception
